notes.title: Team based game modes are now LIVE!
notes.content:
Added 3 new Team based game modes:

 Team Deathmatch: The deathmatch you know and love - now with the power of friendship! Pulverize the competition with your pal’s unconditional support (and a hail of bullets).

 Plant / Defuse the Bomb: In this totally original game mode, two teams take turns planting a bomb in the opponent’s zone, and then making sure said explosive goes kaboom. Be careful though - the planter can’t defend themselves while in the act, and the teams switch sides after 4 rounds. First to 5 successful kablooies wins!

 Knockback Soccer: The world’s game, made better. Compete in teams of two or more, using your bullets instead of your feet to score. And no, you can’t kill your opponents - not directly, anyway.


What are you waiting for? Jump in, have fun and Knock yourself out!
